contracts.commit_point: cur.execute(sql, params) on the psycopg2 cursor inside ToolServer._query (geoagenteval/tools.py:245-246), which submits the interpolated statement over the autocommit connection (line 105) to the sandbox Postgres before conn.close() at line 252.
contracts.declared_mechanism: _safe_ident (geoagenteval/tools.py:255-258) raises ValueError(f"unsafe identifier: {name!r}") when the identifier contains '"' or ';'. It is applied to table_name at every guarded interpolation site: line 126 (COUNT(*) query in _tool_describe_table), line 147 (FROM clause in _real_geometry_columns), line 175 (SELECT ... FROM in _tool_sample_rows), and lines 196/199 (ST_Extent and ST_IsValid queries in _tool_get_geometry_metadata). A raised ValueError propagates out of the _tool_* method and is converted by ToolServer.call's except block (lines 85-88) into an 'ERROR: ...' text result recorded as an errored ToolCallRecord, so the offending SQL never reaches cur.execute.
contracts.forbidden_condition: An identifier destined for f-string interpolation into harness-built SQL contains a double quote ('"') or a semicolon (';') — the exact characters _safe_ident forbids — and reaches ToolServer._query without rejection, enabling quote-escape out of the "..." identifier context or semicolon statement chaining before commit.
pending_binding_information: Agent-loop wiring: the supplied view does not show TOOL_SCHEMAS being passed to a model or model tool_call payloads being forwarded into ToolServer.call; the binding from a live model's tool-call arguments to table_name rests on the function-tool registrations (lines 270-308) and the (name, args) getattr dispatch in ToolServer.call (lines 66-88) plus the docstring designating these as 'the 6 agent tools' (lines 48-50).

Column identifiers (col at lines 146, 196, 199-200; c at line 172) are interpolated into SQL without _safe_ident; they originate from catalog queries filtered by the parameterized table_name (lines 138-142, 157-168), so whether they are agent-controllable beyond that filter is not established by the supplied source.

The sandbox database role's privileges (read-only vs DDL/DML capable) are defined in geoagenteval.sandbox, which is not in the supplied view; this affects the impact bound of the guarded commit point.
contracts.protected_operation: Agent-invoked metadata/introspection tool calls — describe_table (_tool_describe_table), sample_rows (_tool_sample_rows), and get_geometry_metadata (_tool_get_geometry_metadata, including its helper _real_geometry_columns) — constructing and executing harness-built SQL against the sandbox database.
contracts.protected_resource: The sandbox Postgres/PostGIS database reachable via self.sandbox.dsn through the psycopg2 connection opened in ToolServer._query.
contracts.protection_obligation: Agent-supplied table_name arguments to the describe_table, sample_rows, and get_geometry_metadata tools must be rejected before being interpolated into harness-built SQL: _safe_ident must raise ValueError for any identifier containing a double quote or a semicolon, so the agent cannot terminate the quoted identifier or append an extra SQL statement inside ToolServer-constructed queries (COUNT, geometry SRID/type probes, row sampling, ST_Extent, ST_IsValid) executed against the sandbox Postgres/PostGIS database. (Merged from both reviewer opinions, which name the same guard, interpolation sites, and commit point.)
scope_limits: The guard covers only identifiers routed through _safe_ident (table_name at lines 126, 147, 175, 196, 199); column-name values interpolated at lines 146, 172, 196, and 199-200 are DB-catalog-derived and are not passed through _safe_ident in the supplied source.

The guard does not constrain _tool_run_sql (lines 213-217), which by design executes agent-supplied SQL verbatim against the sandbox database, nor the fully static SQL in _tool_list_tables (lines 112-117) or the parameterized catalog queries (e.g., lines 120-124, 138-142, 157-161, 164-168).
The forbidden set is limited to double quote and semicolon characters; _safe_ident enforces no allowlist, length, or other character restrictions.
statement_timeout set in _connect (line 107) and the tool-call budget in ToolServer.call (lines 67-70) are separate harness limits and are not part of this identifier-guard obligation.
The effect target is the sandbox Postgres instance referenced by self.sandbox.dsn; the obligation says nothing about other databases or effect strata.

missing_information: No supplied source shows the agent/LLM runtime that consumes TOOL_SCHEMAS and issues tool calls into ToolServer.call (no chat loop, client, or callback wiring in the view), so the model-to-dispatch hop is inferred from the in-file tool registration, the 'agent tools' docstring, and the (name, args) dispatch surface rather than observed end-to-end.
